title: First-Unit Allowance in Average Daily Use — PAP Therapy Equipment
content:
# First-Unit Allowance in Average Daily Use — PAP Therapy Equipment

**Table.** The first weeks on therapy are allowed for in the average daily use stated on a PAP Therapy Equipment usage summary by how the unit first set up performed, taking the average of its windows:

| Average of the first unit's windows | Hours added |
|---|---|
| under 3.0 hours | 0.2 |
| 3.0 hours or more but under 4.0 hours | 0.1 |
| 4.0 hours or more, or no window from that unit | 0.0 |

The hours are added to the average as it stands, before the stated figure is rounded.

**The first unit's average.** The unit first set up is the unit delivered on the initial rental setup delivery in the device's service history, identified by that delivery's serial number. Its average is the average hours per 24 hours of the 30-night compliance windows downloaded from that serial, summed and divided by the number of those windows, compared unrounded.

## Both sides of each line (hypothetical windows)

| First-unit windows | Their average | Hours added |
|---|---|---|
| 2.9 | 2.9 | 0.2 |
| 3.0 | 3.0 | 0.1 |
| 3.4 and 4.5 | 3.95 | 0.1 |
| 4.0 | 4.0 | 0.0 |
| none | — | 0.0 |
